offering_description.value: Sells customizable stuffed animals and accessories to families, gift buyers and collectors. Shoppers can choose, stuff and dress a plush toy in company or partner workshops, or order a finished toy online. The company also supplies plush merchandise to retail partners and franchisees and licenses its characters and brand.

primary_products.value: Customizable stuffed animals; collectible plush toys; plush clothing and accessories; sound and scent inserts

primary_services.value: In-store birthday parties and group events

customer_segment.value: B2C: Families with children, gift buyers and teen and adult collectors; B2B: Franchisees, specialty retailers, hospitality and entertainment venues, and merchandise licensees

end_markets.value: Toys and collectibles; consumer gifting; family entertainment and tourism

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail and wholesale purchases of plush toys, clothing and accessories; licensing or royalties: Franchise rights and licensed use of the company's brand and characters; service fees: Hosted birthday party and group event packages
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sells plush toys and accessories to families, gift buyers and collectors through workshops and online stores; brand owner: Designs plush merchandise, sources it from contract manufacturers and licenses its brand and characters; distributor: Supplies sourced plush merchandise to franchisees and third-party retail operators

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Ireland, with franchised and partner locations in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Customizable plush, collectibles, accessories, workshop events, franchising and brand licensing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated workshops in shopping centers and tourist destinations; online: Company e-commerce sites selling plush toys, gifts and collectibles; partners / resellers: Franchised workshops and partner-operated locations at resorts, attractions and other venues; third-party retail: Retail partners that carry finished plush merchandise
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; partners / resellers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Children's toys are subject to U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission rules and applicable international toy safety standards.
